description_text:
The file is created in Cinema 4D S24.111.Main archive includes files with extensions .c4d, .max, .obj, .3ds, .fbx(2018) etc. But you can download necessary file formats separately. Also archive includes a game engine folders. Folder unity contains unitypackage format(Unity 2020.3).Folder unreal_engine contains files and folders Unreal Engine 4.27 or 5.0 format.Textures in 4K resolution. 
Polygons: 880Triangles: 1744Vertices: 962
Using:
3DS Max 2022

  - If you using 3ds max 2022, unzip archive 3ds_max.zip, then open file by double-clicking the left mouse button on sledgehammer.max.

  - For use in other scene, use the command: File -> Merge.

Cinema 4D S24
  - If you using Cinema 4D S24, unzip archive 3ds_max.zip, then open file by double-clicking the left mouse button on sledgehammer.c4d.
Other 3d modeling packages:
  - Use command: File - Import and choose sledgehammer.obj or sledeghammer.3ds, or sledgehammer.fbx files.
Unity 2020.3
  - Use command: Assets -> Import Package -> Custom Package... and choose sledgehammer_hdrp.unitypackage or sledgehammer.unitypackage file. It contains in archive unity.zip. Search .unitypackage files in folders HDRP or Universal, dependings what pipeline you use.
Unreal Engine 4.27 or 5.0
  - Unzip unreal_engine.zip archive. Open ue_4_27 or ue_5 folder and copy/paste folder sledgehammer in your unreal engine project directory. For other purposes this folders contains textures and fbx file.Make shure that current project is closed in unreal engine before you copy/paste sledgehammer folder. You need copy it in project_name folder->Content

description_text: modeled in cinema 4d 15 and zbrush. The U.S. M2 60 mm mortar was developed from the heavier 81 mm M1 Mortar to provide a lighter-weight alternative to company-level fire support.[1] The M2 attempted to bridge the gap between the 81 mm mortar and the hand grenade. Normally employed by the weapons platoon of a U.S. infantry company, the M2 is of the usual mortar pattern of the day.[1][2] It consists of a smoothbore metal tube on a rectangular baseplate, supported by a simple bipod with the elevation and traverse mechanisms. The firing pin was fixed in the base cap of the tube, and the bomb was fired automatically when it dropped down the barrel. Though classed as a light mortar, the M2 had considerable range compared to the 50 mm and 60 mm mortars of most other nations, and its fixed-firing pin design allowed a high rate of fire by trained crews.[1]Format : C4D / 3DS / FBX / OBJ.

description_text: On November 3 1957 the soviet union launched Sputnik 2 into orbit, the second ever satellite to reach orbit carrying Laika, the first ever living being in space and making history. Sadly Laika died during the flight - although there had never been plans to bring her back alive she died earlier then expected from overheating due to a cooling system failure sparking a lot of political controversy. Today Laika is seen as a sort of unwilling hero of space exploration. The satellite was launched on a Sputnik rocket, a modified version of the R7 missile and carried several scientific instruments in it's main sphere and the life support capsule for the dog below. At it's 61 anniversary I made a printable 3d model of the spacecraft including a statc cutaway version as well as a version with a  complete but removable launch fairing. The model is full scale but cna be scaled down and is designed with 3d printing in mind so all included details can be printed on an average printer after scaling the model down to 1/20 or 1/10

description_text: The Venture Star also known as X-33 (although the X-33 was technically a smaller test-model version) was a theoretical concept for an SSTO or single-stage-to-orbit rocket developed by Lockheed-Martin for NASA. The Spaceplane would have been powered by 7 joined linear aerospike engines making it more efficient when transitioning from dense atmosphere to vacuum and would have been fuelled by liquid hydrogen and oxygen. A few components were tested but unfortunately the project was cancelled as it became too complex and the new technologies that would have to be developed were considered too expensive.This model is based on the concept design - the model is full scale but designed to be scaled down and printed in an average 3d-printer

description_text: Additional files will be added as we learn moreThe BFR and BFS concept proposed by Space-X has gone through a few iterations so far and htis is the latest one from just today - or late 2018 if you read this someday in the future - I made a detailed approximation including a speculative booster based on what was released so far. The model is easily printable with all thin walls being thickened to be within common 3d-printer feature sizes and the fine details showing in a 1/100 or 1/150 scale model - it includes the measurements and shape of the ship as far as we know, all aerodynamic featrures, the rocket engine bells (31 on the booster, 7 on the ship), as well as lines for the heatshield edge, window outlines, booster gridfins, etcThe download includes original SolidWorks models as well as various polygonal exports for versions of: The default configured ship sitting on the booster, the booster on it's own, the ship on it's own, as well as the ship with the variations of extended landing legs, upward tilted/swept wings as they seem to be on movable hinges, as well as an extended speculative engine bell extender - since the new concept only has sea level optimized raptor engines and a weirdly shaped backplate it is possible htat this is a bell extension that can be hydraulically extended when in vacuum to add to the engines nozzles and increase efficiencythere has been some speculation on how useful the hinged wing design is structurally and in regards to reentry heating and mechanical hinges being exposed to this but further analysis / simulation of the model should bring some understanding into this

description_text:
Villa from South of France
Made with 3D Studio max 8
This model is exact copy of a house situated in the southeast of France, in the region called "Provence".
The product contains all elements of the scene, present in the various presentation pictures :
- The house, with Internal and outside components.
- The ground with grass (Cortaderia selloana).
- The lavande
- The Pampa grass
- the Cypress
- The olive tree.
I did not use dedicated  software to modelise the roof.
Tiles were modelled in one piece, according region standard  ("Romane" style) and placed by duplication,
 on a wood skeleton, as for the real house.
the House and vegetation are included into different archive, to avoid overloading the main scene.
No plugins and special render engine needed, just unzip and render.
Material and texture are included into each archive.

Poly count:
House with all the components:  Poly:697674  Vert:369835
Ground with grass            :  Poly:441264  Vert:293157
Lavanda                      :  Poly:342000  Vert:181000

description_text:
Spur gear collection modeled in Inventor 2010 and provided in multiple file formats (.IPT, .STP, .STL, .3DS, .OBJ). Collection includes 14 spur gear sizes (8-tooth through 64-tooth), fully ready for 3D printing.
The native Inventor files are fully parametric and can be opened and manipulated in any version of the software that is 2010 or newer. The feature trees and parameter tables are logically arranged and clearly labeled, making edits extremely simple.
All gears have been exported as STP files, allowing them to be opened in any 3D CAD software. They have also been exported as 3DS and OBJ files, for use in 3D graphics packages. Finally, they are provided as STL files, making them ready for 3D printing.
Strategic recesses have been engineered into the larger gears to minimize their volume for the purpose of reducing the cost of 3D printing.
No textures or materials included.
Gear specifications:

  - Approximate involute gear tooth profile

  - Minimal backlash between gears

  - 1/4 inch face width

  - 1/4 inch shaft bore

  - 16 Pitch (P) gear size

  - Pitch Diameter (PD) = Gear Teeth (T) / Pitch (P)

  - Outside Diameter (OD) = Pitch Diameter (PD) + 0.125 inch

  - 8-tooth gears provided with 2 types of bore: 1/4 inch round shaft, and 1/4 inch ANSI D-profile shaft

  - 10-tooth through 64-tooth gears provided with bore for 1/4 inch round shaft with standard ANSI 3/32 inch keyway

  - Polygon counts range from 17,544 (8-tooth round) to 37,544 (64-tooth keyway)

Product includes:

  - 14 spur gear Inventor 2010 files (.IPT)

  - 14 spur gear STP files (for other 3D CAD packages)

  - 14 spur gear STL files (for 3D printing)

  - 14 spur gear 3DS files (for 3D graphics packages)

  - 14 spur gear OBJ files (for 3D graphics packages)

  - Sample spur gear animation (.AVI)

in the scene without correcting the external original file, that is, the same original model may have each own unique color solution in each of your
scenes.Absolute advantage of such approach is the small size of the work file which gives an opportunity to use regular equipment without using expensive
professional machines.If for some reasons you are not a fan of using external links in your projects – don’t get upset. Our product is completed with the scene where all the

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of U.S. Ambulance Vehicle.  The Interior part is also modeled and textured but with less detail.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 5304 Triangles

  - 3117 Polygons

  - 3227 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into main part and wheels.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - Blender files and example render scenes (Eevee studio setup and Cycles HDRI)

  - Blender files in 2 versions (packed and regular-unpacked)

  - Unity3D 2018.4 (.unitypackage)

  - Unreal Engine 4.27 (.uasset)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - 3ds Max 2018 (.max)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

  - Please also contact me if there are any problems after purchase. We will try to solve the problem together ;)

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

description_text:
Low poly of Cartoon Mushroom Village made with 3D Studio Max

The scene contains all the objects visible in the presentation picture, for ALL formats:
- 6 diffrent shapes of mushroom
- The ground.
- The bush.
- The flowers.
- the stonewall.
- The wheelbarrow.
- the well.
- the fork.
- The grass
- The scale

In the .Max file, the grass is made with the plugin Hair and fur, included into the standard tools of
3D Studio Max, and converted into mesh for the exchange formats (.obj, .fbx)
The lights are set for volumetric light effect. 
You just need to put the mushrooms and the different objects where you want and ajust the camera.
No special render engine needed, just unzip and render.
The mesh is clean and quad only. The polycount (456666) concerns the amount of ALL objetcs. Mushrooms have an average
of 5000 polygons.
All part of mushroom (door, windows, etc..) are separated objects, so you can use them separately (open, close ...)
this model is perfect for game, animation, or illustration. Textures are large enough to be used with a close view.
Textures and materials are included into each archive. available formats: (.Max 8, .Obj, .fbx)

description_text:
Cute little hamster made with 3D Studio Max 8  
In Max version only, the model is rigged (mouth, spine, pelvis, head, arms, legs, fingers).
The hairs are obtained with the plugins Hair and Fur , included in 3D Studio MAx tools.
In the archive file containing the MAX files, I have created three scenes with different sizes and aspect of hairs.
The scene in Max files are exactly the same than the presentation pictures with background and volume light effect.
No special render engine needed, just unzip and render.
The model is finely skined, the mesh is clean and Quad only, is very easy to anime, and perfect for game.  
*Important FBX and UnityPackage files are RIGGED too *
Available in following formats: 3ds, obj, Fbx, Max 8, unity.  
The exchanges formats (3ds, obj)  are not rigged and not hairs. They are UVW mapped with the same textures than the native file, so the render
is the same than the presentation picture with no fur (no backgound and no light effect too) .
Exchange formats are quad only.  
a readme file is present to explain how very easily replace the texture. A PSD file is also included to help you make your own textures.  
Textures materials are included into each archive.

description_text:
Low Poly of Cute little dog made with 3D Studio Max 8
In Max version only, the model is rigged ( spine, pelvis, head, arms, legs, foots).
Some morphing targets has been added for the facial animation (Open mouth, tongue, ears, eyes).

a readme file is present to explain how very easily replace the texture. A PSD file is also included to help you make your own textures.
Textures materials are included into each archive.

Low Poly of Dark Wolf made with 3D Studio Max 8

The Original PSD file is included, allowing you to change easily the texture

This model is Print ready: size in cm : 7,15 x 10,19 x 8,08

description_text:
This is a set of 4 buildings for you to create your own fantasy or medieval castle scenes.The smallest building, the Stable, has enough space for 2 or 3 horses.The Main Stable includes hay bales, space for 3 or 4 horses, and an upper story where the stable staff can live.The Kitchen building is a two-story building with an interior.
The largest building is the Castle:There are two courtyards with buildings- the first courtyard includes the banquet hall (with interior) and a well. The second courtyard includes the king's room, also with an interior.The drawbridge at the front of the castle is two separate parts, which can be hidden or shown, depending on whether you want visitors or not.A second set of stairs on the right side allows for a rear-door escape if needed.The eight towers provide look-out posts for guards or archers and the numerous walkways allow them to quickly move between the towers.
Product Features:* Includes the following models in obj format:- Castle, at 39,516 polygons. Includes a drawbridge, buildings inside the walls, banquet hall and king`s chamber interiors, plenty of stairs, walkways, ledges, and more!- Kitchen, at 10,560 polygons. Includes a full interior (with a chair and table) and walls which can be hidden (to see the interior).- Main Stable, at 3,855 polygons. Includes 3 hay bales which are separate groups.- Stable, at 767 polygons.
Note: Although your software will read the group information, these models are not rigged.
Textures:One set of texture maps, at 2048x2048 pixels, many of which include corresponding normal/ bump maps.
Original model by Arteria3D and uploaded for sale here with full permission.

description_text: A 3D-Printable scale model of the theoretical concept of the Saturn 8 rocket.During the early pases of the Apollo and Saturn programs that would ultimately bring humans to the moon and back several alternative concepts had been proposed until after careful analysis the one we now now as the historic Apollo missions and Saturn V rockets were chosen. One of these concepts was the much simpler but also trickier to build direct ascent concept which would have been launched by an even bigger version of the Saturn V (or Saturn 5) rocket known as the Saturn 8 - unlike the Saturn V having 5 F1 engines powering hte first stage this one would have had 8 and the overall mass and power of the rocket would have scaled accordingly. It would have been over 120 meter high, making it the biggest and most powerful rocket in history - had it ever been flown. Unfortunately for such an interesting concept it never left the drawing board in favor of the smaller Saturn V which nonetheless remains the biggest and most powerful rocket ever actually flown to this day.The concept had both advantages and disadvantages over the Apollo program as it ended up being realized.The idea of the direct ascent mission was simple: A single spacecraft, a lot of fuel, you fly off to the moon, enter it's orbit, slow down, land there, later take off from there again and fly back to earth seperating the command module with it's heatshield from the service module to land safely in the ocean. No docking in orbit and none of the additional risk attached to this at the time, also all 3 rather then only 2 of the astronauts would have landed on the moon.The Apollo program as it was actually realized instead saved a lot of fuel by using a small lander only built for landing on the moon - they left the heavy service and command module, the heatshield, the parachutes, the fuel for the return to earth and the rest in moon orbit, landed only the lander and returned to to the command module after launching from the moon to then switched back to the command module, left the tiny lander at  the moon and flew back ot earth. While this made the mission more complicated and risky it saved a lot of fuel meaning the mission could be launched with a smaller rocket - one that could actually be built at the time. The Saturn 8 would have required the construction of new facilities first which would have delayed the mission past the ambitious in this decade goal set by Kennedy in his historic speach and so the Saturn V was chosen instead.

description_text: A design for an SSTO (Single Stage To Orbit) spaceplane I came up with - it's only a theoretical concept but it is an actual calculated design for an actual rocketplane, not just a sci-fi design - powered by 28 small methane engines with a wingspan of 16 meters this lifting body design could lift about 3000 kilograms into low earth orbit or about 1000 kilograms into geostationary orbit while being fully reusable. The model is slightly modified from the aerodynamics model to be printable - it is still full scale but both the rudder fins and the engine bells have been thickened so they are still printable with a normal printer nozzle when scaled downthe lower side geometry is purposely simple in order to make the heatshield easier to manufacture in one or few partsthe wing area to weight ratio or wingload is kept extremely light to reduce reentry temperatures and the geometry has a high aerodynamic aoa range allowing it to both fly with a high aoa during the hot phase of reentry to reduce heatflow while also being able to fly at low aoa during the colder phase and final landing glideslopw in order to glide more efficiently and give it more crossrange

description_text: The Merlin 1D is the current and most likely final version of the Merlin rocket engine family developed by Space-X for their Falcon rockets, both the Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy and currently used in the Falcon 9 Block 5 together with the vacuum optimized version.The engine runs on RP-1 LOX (rocket grade kerosene  and liquid oxygen) fed at cryogenic temperatures. It has a specific impulse of 282 seconds at sea level or 311 seconds in vacuum (348 seconds for the vacuum optimzied version) and a thrust of p to 914kNIt's nozzle bell has a bottom diameter of 1250mm and it is obviously relightable as it is used in the reusable Falcon 9 rocket performing powered landings.The model is full scale and contains all major features while the ones too fine to print in a desk model have been left out. It can be easily printed wen scaled down by a factor of about 1/10 making the overall engine 270mm high.It can be used as a desk model or lamp itself or as a part for larger scale rocket models.

description_text: During the end of the space race the N1-L3 was a last attempt by the soviet space program to create a rocket that could put humans on the moon - and while there are quite a few substancial differences to the American Apollo and Saturn V program it is still often compared as it was the closest competitor that existed and to some degree that comparison works. It's history was vastly difference with the Apollo porgram being ground up designed to put humans o nthe moon while the N1-L3 was a modified version of the N1 program which was originally conceived for interplanetary flybys without landing. The N1 had less efficiency and performance (the concept called for 3 people to orbit anand one to land on the moon ratehr then 3 and two as in the Apollo program) and most famously used many small engines rather then few large ones with it's first stage running 30 main engines. Several testflights were conducted but all of them failed though arguably due to execution / technical limitations at the time rather then the concept itself. The N1 is also one great example for gridfins being used as stabilizers/fins on the first stage base to help controlling the rockets ascent. It also featured completely spherical tanks stacked ontop of each other within conical fairings as well as the open grid interstage known from the russian space program but on a massive scale. While it never worked it still has a strange fascination for rocket science enthusiasts so I made a 3d-printable scale model. The model is full scaled but small features and the engine nozzles have been thickened so that when the model is scaled down to fit into a printer they can still be pritned with an average nozzlethe pack features STL's for both the whole rocket as well as separate stages as far up as stage 3

description_text:
Attention: THIS MODEL IS NOT INTENDED FOR 3D PRINTING. The meshes are NOT WATERTIGHT. The meshes are optimized for 3d game engines, the inside faces are deleted to save on tris count.
This pack contains 6 corvettes, ready to reinforce your fleet. They can be used in space RTS games, in a sidescroller or in a top-down shoot’em up.
The models are unskinned, unrigged and have no animations. Almost all 3D applications/game engines have their own built-in toolset for keyframe animations. Use this to create e.g. firing animations, etc.

  -   6 corvettes

  -   Separate turrets, missile mount, gun barrel

  -   Corvettes have modular design

  -   2 different missiles

  -   Changeable decals on all corvettes

  -   8 damage decals

  -   6 different texture sets for all models

  -   PBR textures for specular and metalness workflow

  -   Texture sizes are 1024

  -   Tris count ca. 430 - 850

  -   Final tris count depends on how many weapons are used for a ship

The textures can be used in a PBR environment (specular and metalness workflow) as well as a non PBR environment.

  -   Albedo map, PNG format

  -   AlbedoAO map, PNG format – this albedo map has the ambient occlusion backed into it

  -   Ambient Occlusion (AO) map, PNG format

  -   Illumination map, Targa format 32 bit with alpha channel

  -   Normal map, PNG format

  -   Specular map, PNG format

  -   Gloss map, PNG format

  -   Metalness map, PNG format

Depending on your game engine/3D application you may need to rescale the models.

description_text: Этот дом располагает 3 спальнями, 2,5 ванными комнатами и всеми вкусностями, что избирательное желание покупателей жилой недвижимости. Большое фойе в окружении кабинет со стеной книжных шкафов и столовой с подносом потолка. Дальше в дом-это двухэтажный большой номер с всю стену арочными окнами и камином в окружении более книжные шкафы и встроенные модули. Кухня примыкает к большой комнате с большой счетчик и шкаф пространства, прилагается зона для завтрака/очаг комната с высоким потолком и каменным камином и выходом в гараж с отдельной прихожей. Добив на первом этаже находится гостевая комната с гардеробной и полной ванной комнатой. Наверху, в грандиозной высадке дает потрясающий вид на большой зал и соединяет верхние комнаты. Мастер люкс с потолка лоток, спа-ванная комната и большой встроенный шкаф с зеркалом в полный рост. Большая прачечная и подсобное помещение находится рядом с главной комнатой. Другой запасная спальня с гостиной зоной, встроенным шкафом, и ванная комната завершает второй уровень. Многие пользовательские отделки включают высокие плинтусы, построенная потолочная лепнина, wainscotings потолками, inticate плитки, скругленные углы стены, и многое другое. Все светильники находятся шахты или в sketchup. Корона литья профиля кредит Timbron Международного.

description_text:
An Industrial Diesel Generator 3d model as described below. 
"A diesel generator is the combination of a diesel engine with an electric generator (often an alternator) to generate electrical energy. This is a specific case of engine-generator. A diesel compression-ignition engine is usually designed to run on diesel fuel, but some types are adapted for other liquid fuels or natural gas.
Diesel generating sets are used in places without connection to a power grid, or as emergency power-supply if the grid fails, as well as for more complex applications such as peak-lopping, grid support and export to the power grid.
Proper sizing of diesel generators is critical to avoid low-load or a shortage of power. Sizing is complicated by the characteristics of modern electronics, specifically non-linear loads. In size ranges around 50 MW and above, an open cycle gas turbine is more efficient at full load than an array of diesel engines, and far more compact, with comparable capital costs; but for regular part-loading, even at these power levels, diesel arrays are sometimes preferred to open cycle gas turbines, due to their superior efficiencies."   -Wikipedia
Model was created in Maya, PBR textured with the Quixel Suite and rendered using Unreal Engine  and 3DO. Maya ascii file and FBX included. Maya file contains uncombined groups making it easily editable. 
Textures are 4096x4096 and include Albedo, Ambient Occlusion, Metallic/Metalness, Normal, and Roughness Targa maps for integration into real time rendering engines such as Unreal Engine or Marmoset Toolbag, etc. 
It is a great environment asset for architectural pre-visualization as well as industrial or city game environments. 
*Please note turntable stand, concrete slab, and McDonald's litter is not included in this product listing.

description_text:
The Consolidated PBY Catalina, also known as the Canso in Canadian service, is an American flying boat, and later an amphibious aircraft of the 1930s and 1940s produced by Consolidated Aircraft. It was one of the most widely used seaplanes of World War II. Catalinas served with every branch of the United States Armed Forces and in the air forces and navies of many other nations.
During World War II, PBYs were used in anti-submarine warfare, patrol bombing, convoy escort, search and rescue missions (especially air-sea rescue), and cargo transport. The PBY was the most numerous aircraft of its kind and the last active military PBYs were not retired from service until the 1980s. In 2014, nearly 80 years after its first flight, the aircraft continues to fly as a waterbomber (or airtanker) in aerial firefighting operations all over the world.

description_text:
With these files, 26 AWG enameled copper magnet wire, two common 608 ball bearings, 12 3/4 inch x 1/8 inch neodymium magnets, and a 16d nail, you can build yourself a 10V DC generator that fits in the palm of your hand in about 2 hours.  You'll need to print one of everything and 3 bearing diameter adaptors.  To wind the copper, weave the wire around the arms in the winding guide around 100 turns, up and down.  This can then be fitted into the outer casing along with one 608 bearing.  Attatch your 12 magnets together in sets of two, and then insert the pairs into the slots of the magnet holster.  Put your other 608 bearing into the hole in the top plate, and fit two of your bearing adaptors into each of the ball bearings.  Put the 16d nail in through the top plate bearing, and through the magnet holster with about a 1/16th inch tolerance between the two.  Fit your last bearing adaptor onto the nail up to the bottom of the bearing holster and glue everything in place.  Finally, fit the nail through the bearing adaptor in the bearing of the outer casing and fit the top plate in.  From there, you can attatch a hand crank or turbine head onto the nail, and generate electricity!
Note, 3D printed 608 ball beaings can be used in this project, but will result in less smooth revolution.

description_text:
A bogie is a frame, placed under the trains, onto which the wheels of the railway vehicle are fixed. As bogies are mobile in relation to the frame of the vehicle itself, they can notably be used to facilitate movement on curved tracks.Each bogie is a 4-wheeled or 6-wheeled truck that provides the support for the vehicle body and which is used to provide its traction and braking. Each carriage (called a car in North America and some other English speaking countries and still so called in the electric traction business) has two bogies.
The Norfolk engine bogie is unique in it suspension system which utilizes a series of cross mounted, leaf springs in the bolster box as opposed to the standard coil springs used in nearly every other bogie syste.
This model is a version 1 series and incorporates materials only. No time has been put into texturing or mapping it.As such you can add your own textures or mapping or use it in its flat condition at discount.Ver2.0 will be available soon and will incorporate the additional texturing time and be priced higher.
This model comes as three seperate pieces.The right bogie, the right transmissions, the left bogie and transmissions and the turntable.As such it is adjustable to your track width.A track will also be available in the near future.

description_text:
Mr.Sorn is an experienced graffiti writer and recently turned tattoo artist. This graffiti sculpture was developed from a model I had originally used in an animation. The piece had been painted back in 2007, and is a classic example of his distinct funky lettering.
Please check out his website www.MrSorn.com
DESCRIPTION
I have made it in 3 pieces to allow for a bigger print on smaller printers. I found using quite heavy supports allowed for a cleaner print but time and care is needed removing them.
Printing at 0.15mm layer height, with 50% infill. The 3 pieces combined take a total of 15 hours 3 minutes and uses 87.7g of filament.
If printing on a printer with a larger print size, then the whole object sorn_Rescaled_20_.stl can be printed at the same settings using slightly less filament and time to print.

description_text:
Destructible Props Pack is a game ready, low poly asset bundle that consist of:

  - 6 fences

  - 5 tables

  - 5 benchesthat can be fractured runtime in the game engine your choice. High-quality 2K resolution PBR textures are provided (Metalness workflow). Poly count on average is a few hundred per model.

Models are availble in .FBX format (7.4 binary) and .BLEND as well. Materials and textures are named conventionally. Texture maps are Albedo, Metallic, Gloss, Normal, Occlusion. UV's are non-overlapping and all models come with a separate lightmap UV channel.
Shader configuration information: Metallic maps store gloss map data in their alpha channels. If you need roughness map, invert that alpha map value (Unreal Engine). For Unity3D, textures are configured for Standard shader. All textures use lossless formats (.PNG and .TIFF). All models were hand sculpted and baked off to low-poly ones, textures were created with attention to detail using Substance Painter and Designer.
Braking objects: Trigger destructive event, replace intact model with fractured one and apply physics to fractured meshes. Models are pivoted and scaled properly to be replaced unnoticed by the camera. Low-poly collider meshes are provided for all irregular shaped objects.
Try how it works in your browser: Benches: http://goo.gl/iYJgaRTables: http://goo.gl/TWuSh3Fences: http://goo.gl/vlTvqq
Note: You might need to scale models if using Unreal Engine 4.Performance info: Mesh topology is clean, parts are triangulated to reduce vertex count as much as possible. Fractured models consist of 40-60 separate meshes, strongly advised to remove debris from the scene after a few seconds for optimal runtime performance.
Should you have any questions/concerns before purchase, feel free to send me a message on here!
(The download package only contains 3D artwork, no game mechanics or pseudo code.)

description_text:
Ice houses were buildings used to store ice throughout the year, prior to the invention of the refrigerator. The most common designs involved underground chambers, usually man-made, which were built close to natural sources of winter ice such as freshwater lakes.
During the winter, ice and snow would be taken into the ice house and packed with insulation, often straw or sawdust. It would remain frozen for many months, often until the following winter, and could be used as a source of ice during summer months. This could be used simply to cool drinks, or allow ice-cream and sorbet desserts to be prepared.

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

description_text:
3D model of Microwave Oven with Grill.
MODEL

  - Model dimensions: LWH 51,0 x 40,1 x 30,5 cm (20.1 x 15.8 x 12.0 in).

  - Without subdivision -

  - Verts - 289 024

  - With level 2 subdivision -

  - Polys - 330 565

  - Verts - 326 884

MATERIALS

  - Materials are prepared for Corona and V-ray renderers.

  - Scanline and FBX files has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images.

  - OBJ file has no materials, but has UVW coordinates intact.

TEXTURES

  - Model has 6 high quality textures of up to 1024 x 1024 resolution.

  - Textures are saved in JPEG and PNG formats.

  - Textures are collected in one archive and are delivered in separate file.

SCENE

  - Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm.

  - Objects, materials and textures has meaningful and matching names.

  - Transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].

  - Texture paths are set to relative. Just unzip texture archive into a folder where the model is located and your 3D app should pick up them automatically.

RIG

  - Microwave oven's door are rigged with convenient helper which allows easily and conveniently open and close the door. Door movement is restricted accordingly  to real world counterpart.

  - FBX file has simplyfied rig.

  - OBJ file is not rigged.

FILE FORMATS

  - 3ds Max - Corona

  - 3ds Max - Scanline

  - 3ds Max - Vray

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - GLB

GENERAL

  - Modeled in 3ds max.

  - Preview images are rendered with Corona renderer. Images are straight from 3ds Max. No post processing appart from Corona renderer built in tonemapping tools, were applied.

  - Render scenes are not included.

description_text:
One of Malay traditional fishing methods that were used back in the days. The bubu is made of bamboo, with rattan rings as frames.  Bubu also can be called as 'traps' or 'guiding barrier'. It can be carried with hand or to shoulder depending on the size. It is designed to work without attendance.
This type of fishing normally known and used by the local fishermans who lived near the sea, or river which usually placed on shallow water. It also works in the pond. 
The way Bubu works is by placing the bait inside the body of bubu and letting the fish to take the bait on a one-way path only through the funnel. While the other side is the door of the bubu for collecting the trapped fishes.

description_text: The house is located on a small site in conditions of chaotically urbanized area. Practically from all sides the building is surrounded by neighbours ( including multistory one). Those rather difficult conditions had an influence on a somewhat strange image of the house. The window openings are defined in a shape of stationary window shades which have solid stained glass. Because of such a solution, the owners can look inside but the neighbors can not. The vertical functional zoning of the house is traditional. There is a garage and storerooms in the basement. On the first floor a living room, a kitchen and a dining room are situated. The second floor is traditionally a sleeping one and there are rooms for leisure and playing.

description_text:
This model was built near to scale within couple of percent of actual general dimensions.  It has materials to give it a realistic appearance.  It can be used in airport tarmac and cargo area scenes around aircraft.  
IATA 6 cargo containers are used in the organized loading of cargo into lower or belly cargo compartments on larger aircraft.  They are built to be used to fill up the lower compartment maximizing capacity from one side to the other while still being able to be loaded through the lower compartment access loading door.  Each container would be loaded one at a time based on contents, weight and destination.

description_text:
This wheel is a 100 percent hassle free 3D printable toy. No plastic support material is required to print it. If you have a printer which has problems with bed adhesion you may have to use a basic raft but in most cases this is not needed as the tire and wheel are perfectly flat on the bottom layer and most printers even a 101 Hero can easily print this model.
The wheel has been 3D printed and fully tested to make sure the part is strong and works well on every printer. It should not require any glue for assembly but if your printer has issues in maintaining size accuracy you may have to add some to secure the inner part if you print it in 2 parts. 
You have the option of printing the model as one part and then painting it or you can print it in two parts, then paint them separately  and then assemble them later. The assembly process is easy and works even if you use PLA. Of course should you use ABS watch out for possible shrinking of the inner wheel as it is designed to be perfect for PLA only.
The mesh is very low poly so it will be super easy and fast to make any scaling, rotating or other editing to it although not of that should be required as the STL file is already positioned correctly for your easy printing experience.
Also the scale of the wheel is exactly measured to fit your 1 24 scale RC car.The PLA configuration is perfect for drift car wheels however if you want to make it rubbery you will need to use ABS or coat the exterior of the wheel with grip type material.

description_text:
This Antique Fireplace model is low poly and includes the FREE animated 'Flaming Pear' shown in the demos. It's poly/vertices counts are P=3024, V=1514. 
A video clip demonstrating 'Flaming Pear' animation can be viewed on Youtube - http://youtu.be/nQvDHdQE2CA 
The Antique Fireplace model and logs are UV mapped in 2048 X 2048 pixels. Color, gloss, displacement and normal maps are provided. The log cradle model is finished in a near-black color and is not UV mapped.  The 'Flaming Pear'is video textured. A PNG image sequence with alpha channels and a GIF animation are provided, in the event that your software does not accept video texturing.
In pre-release testing, 3DS Max accepted video texturing with alpha channel of both FBX and DAE 'Flaming Pear' animation, but dropped deformers. In Maya, new material nodes must be created as either Movie or File type with image sequence. Maya and 3DS Max import AntiqueFireplace01.fbx with nmap, but do not import  AntiqueFireplace01.dae or fireplace02.obj with nmap. The AntiqueFireplace01.fbx imports into Unreal Engine 4 without problems and it is recommended to use the Particle Fire, rather than the included 'Flaming Pear' in Unreal Engine 4. However, the 'Flaming Pear' can be used with Movie media and texture coordinate nodes in a material.
Uploading required individual packaging of assets. Files included in the 9 ZIP files should be unpacked to the following folders for best results:...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\AntiqueFireplace\AntiqueFireplace01.daeAntiqueFireplace01.fbxfireplace02.mtlfireplace02.objfireplace02_default_disp.pngfireplace02_default_disp.tifffireplace02_default_gloss.pngfireplace02_default_nmap.pngfireplace02c_default_color.png...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\FlamingPear\FireLoop.aviFlamingPear.daeFlamingPear.fbxFlamingPear.mtlFlamingPear.obj...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\LogCrade\logcradle1.mtllogcradle1.obj...\AntiqueFireplace01\Assets\Logs\log2.mtllog2.objlog2_Texture_0_color.pnglog2_Texture_0_disp.tifflog2_Texture_0_disp.pnglog2_Texture_0_nmap.png...\AntiqueFireplace01\Movie\FireLoop (1).aviFireLoop (2).aviFireLoop (2).gifFireLoop.aviFireLoop2.avi...\AntiqueFireplace01\SourceImages\FireLoopImgs\FireLoopAlpha000.png - FireLoopAlpha313.png
